headline: Comcast Plans Significant Job Cuts Amid Cable TV Subscriber Decline
summary: US media group Comcast is planning significant job cuts as part of a reorganization driven by ongoing losses of cable TV subscribers to streaming alternatives.
why: Comcast is a major US telecommunications and media conglomerate navigating the secular decline of traditional cable television.

impacts.name: Comcast
impacts.why: Restructuring and layoffs aim to reduce operating costs amid cord-cutting trends.
